synth.notes:
Ring+beam vertical moves carry on-beam blocks and push the blocks they hit in a chain; the whole move is cancelled if any block would leave y[2,58].
Extend/retract changes beam w by 6 (1..43). A hooked next/collected block at tip-4 drags every on-beam block; when not hooked, extending pushes next/collected blocks in the swept columns.
If any moved block would go past x>48 or into the ring, the blocks stay and only the beam changes. This is what happens at step 128: the hooked collected block_12 drags the group, block_9 would reach x=54, so the beam extends alone.
Tags: a hooked next block becomes collected when every other on-beam block is collected, and the rightmost todo becomes next. With no hook, a collected block off the beam reverts to next.
Stateless (no hidden counter needed). Ring y bounds [0,58] are assumed because they were never observed.
